why: This is a California TK teacher-workforce policy and credentialing pathway design for specified candidate pools, not a reusable instructional element or named instructional product.

The TK-SRL framework is a source-specific teacher-knowledge framework and coding lens that applies Self-Regulated Learning to teachers' knowledge, not a general learning theory or a standalone research method.
The TKTP is a named, study-specific physics assessment instrument rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: Transfer of Knowledge Test in Physics (TKTP)
product_description: A 50-item multiple-choice physics assessment developed by Akinbobola to measure senior secondary students' transfer of knowledge from heat energy to sound and light energy concepts.
